params.topic: Bundesliga eight-season incremental supplement of non-Qimen match facts and bookmaker odds
questions: For Bundesliga seasons 2018-19 through 2025-26, reconcile row-level non-Qimen fields using identity key season, match_date, home_team, away_team. Return only rows or cells that are missing, conflicting, or newly evidenced, plus a season-level coverage manifest for all 2448 matches.

Where available, collect kickoff date/time with timezone, venue, round or matchday, home and away team names, 90-minute final score, home and away goals, and 90-minute result. Keep extra time, penalties, aggregate and qualification separate and do not substitute them for the 90-minute result.

For Bet365, Pinnacle, and William Hill separately, collect directly evidenced 1X2 and total-goals/OU fields. Preserve bookmaker label exactly as displayed. Keep true opening, pre-closing, closing, and historical tick semantics separate. If true opening is unavailable, return pre-closing and/or closing with explicit O_PRE_CLOSE or O_CLOSE labels; never rename them opening and never infer values.

Prioritize known gaps: 2018-19 Bet365 and William Hill closing 1X2 fields, 2025-26 William Hill 1X2 fields, William Hill OU fields, Pinnacle OU fields, missing kickoff/venue/round fields, and any row-level identity or score gaps. Report exact missing-cell counts; a column's presence alone does not prove all its rows are complete.

For each returned value include source_url, final_url when different, fetched_at, source_hash when possible, bookmaker, market, field_semantics, and evidence notes. Put differing source values into conflicts rather than choosing automatically.

Do not collect, infer, reconstruct, or return Qimen charts, palace tokens, Q/F/G/I/M tokens, model directions, predictions, Miss labels, or post-match model features. This request is strictly for non-Qimen facts and odds evidence for a later local join.

Return machine-readable rows and manifest with audit totals by season: expected, discovered, identity_matched, complete, partial, unavailable, conflicts, and unresolved_queue. State whether each field is suitable for O_INTERVAL and identify exact rows still requiring human supplementation.

known_local_context.fallback_semantics: O_PRE_CLOSE and O_CLOSE only when directly evidenced; true opening remains separate

params.note_to_codex: Fresh unique Bundesliga request. Do not write this response into SQ, do not create Qimen output, and do not run O_INTERVAL until local identity join and provenance validation are completed.
